checklist: The Edit canvas with nothing compiled (probe.sh edit runs this with LUMINA_KERNEL_SALT set, so neither Core Image nor Metal's on-disk cache has seen the stage programs: the first launch after an update that changed a kernel). Drags the way the page does (the whole look, one slider changing) on sliders whose stage the canvas has not rendered: vibrance (a colour kernel), shadows (a blur stage), then exposure down to exactly 0 (a stage leaving the graph). Each drag waits for the warm-up to go idle first, as a person reaching for a slider does, and is gated like the other drags (p95 ≤ 16 ms, 0 dropped, rest ≤ 120 ms) plus: the main-thread time of the first render of each new set of stages ≤ 8 ms, and the drag must have rendered one. LUMINA_CANVAS_WARM=0 turns the warm-up off (the 'before' measure: the first-render gate then fails). Folder: LUMINA_EDIT_DIR.

steps.src: const l=__probe.logic(); const p=l.real[Math.min(1,l.real.length-1)]; window.__editRel=p.path; return lumina.edit.enter(p.path, 'ev:+0.30 con:+10').then(f=>JSON.stringify(f))

steps.what: bases built and the first frame shown (or the first image shown)
